name: Invocation: Treacherous Crows

description.content: While in the Basement next to the circle, use <Activate Ability> to invoke. While invoking, other Survivors see your Aura and can join in.

items: Whenever the Killer scares a Crow while a Survivor is in their Terror Radius, all Survivors see the Killer's Aura for [2s].

description.content: Each Invocation can only be completed once per trial.

quote: "Remember your training. They taught you all about the crows." -Taurie Cain
